    {"name": "industry_cloud_infrastructure", "role": "predictor", "is_predictor": true, "is_interpretable_segmentation": true, "rationale": "Well-balanced (63/199) interpretable industry membership flag, good for segmentation."},
    {"name": "industry_healthcare_biotech", "role": "predictor", "is_predictor": true, "is_interpretable_segmentation": false, "rationale": "Interpretable but very sparse (9 positives); limited comparative power across many regions."},
    {"name": "industry_fintech_payments", "role": "predictor", "is_predictor": true, "is_interpretable_segmentation": false, "rationale": "Interpretable category but near-constant (4 positives); too rare for meaningful regional comparison."},
    {"name": "industry_data_analytics", "role": "predictor", "is_predictor": true, "is_interpretable_segmentation": true, "rationale": "Balanced (43) interpretable industry flag, good for grouping."},
    {"name": "industry_enterprise_software", "role": "predictor", "is_predictor": true, "is_interpretable_segmentation": true, "rationale": "Interpretable flag with adequate positives (21) for segmentation."},
    {"name": "industry_semiconductors", "role": "predictor", "is_predictor": true, "is_interpretable_segmentation": false, "rationale": "Interpretable but very sparse (6); weak comparison basis."},
    {"name": "industry_consumer_media", "role": "predictor", "is_predictor": true, "is_interpretable_segmentation": true, "rationale": "Interpretable industry flag with usable prevalence (25)."},
    {"name": "industry_venture_capital", "role": "predictor", "is_predictor": true, "is_interpretable_segmentation": true, "rationale": "Interpretable flag (17 positives); relevant trait to segment regions on."},
    {"name": "geographic_region", "role": "restatement", "is_predictor": false, "is_interpretable_segmentation": false, "rationale": "This is a discretized version of the focus (regional clustering itself); it restates rather than provides an external explanatory trait."},
    {"name": "region_industry_concentration", "role": "restatement", "is_predictor": false, "is_interpretable_segmentation": false, "rationale": "Values map one-to-one onto geographic_region counts; it is a proxy encoding of the region (focus), not an independent explanatory variable."},
    {"name": "regional_industry_penetration", "role": "irrelevant", "is_predictor": false, "is_interpretable_segmentation": false, "rationale": "Opaque, fine-grained numeric score (many distinct fractional values) derived from region; not interpretable categories and effectively restates region-level aggregates."},

    {"name": "industry_enterprise_software.1", "role": "restatement", "is_predictor": false, "is_interpretable_segmentation": false, "rationale": "Duplicate column."},
    {"name": "industry_semiconductors.1", "role": "restatement", "is_predictor": false, "is_interpretable_segmentation": false, "rationale": "Duplicate column."},
    {"name": "industry_consumer_media.1", "role": "restatement", "is_predictor": false, "is_interpretable_segmentation": false, "rationale": "Duplicate column."},
    {"name": "industry_venture_capital.1", "role": "restatement", "is_predictor": false, "is_interpretable_segmentation": false, "rationale": "Duplicate column."},
    {"name": "geographic_region.1", "role": "restatement", "is_predictor": false, "is_interpretable_segmentation": false, "rationale": "Duplicate restatement of the focus."},
    {"name": "region_industry_concentration.1", "role": "restatement", "is_predictor": false, "is_interpretable_segmentation": false, "rationale": "Duplicate proxy encoding of region."},
    {"name": "regional_industry_penetration.1", "role": "irrelevant", "is_predictor": false, "is_interpretable_segmentation": false, "rationale": "Duplicate opaque region-derived score."}
  ],
  "n_predictors": 10,
  "relationship_informativeness": 0.4,
  "rationale": "The distinct industry membership flags are genuine external, interpretable traits that can be segmented and cross-tabulated against regional clustering, which is exactly the exploratory relationship sought. However, the set is heavily contaminated: every column is duplicated (.1 suffix), adding no information; geographic_region and region_industry_concentration restate the focus itself; and regional_industry_penetration is an opaque, fine-grained region-derived score with no interpretable categories. Because roughly half the columns are restatements/duplicates/opaque and only the ~10 unique industry flags (a few too sparse to compare) truly enable interpretable segmentation, the set only partially realises the exploratory-analysis claim."
}
